source.notes: Top-level request parameters listed on the provider's chat API reference (accessed 2026-10-17). Nested shapes are not modelled. Page in Chinese. response_format: text, json_object, json_schema. tool_choice: none, auto, required, or {type: function, function: {name}}. stop up to 4 entries of max 20 chars. max_completion_tokens overrides max_tokens; both count reasoning. cached_tokens documented as only for ERNIE-4.0-Turbo-8K. Response may also include search_results, reasoning_content, flag, ban_round.
